metadata.framework: ansible (in-house CLI/plugin automation framework; not a web framework)
notes: Labeling performed by glm-5.3 running as the Claude Code CLI agent (lead) plus 8 fork subagents of the same model; every judgment is LLM-authored against the real source tree at dataset/codeql_databases/ansible_vuln (read-only).
Deterministic single-pass judgment; no sampling temperature applies (CLI agent reasoning, not a temperature-sampled API completion).
Scope: Pass 2 restricted to CWE-78 (OS command injection) per user request. Pass 1 is a schema-compatibility placeholder with empty entries, per user instruction.

labels_raw_pass2.json contains all 1665 per-candidate-row labels (1249 source rows + 416 sink rows from iris/extraction/*.csv, none skipped); labels.json contains the deduplicated signature-level view.
One sanitizer entry (shlex_quote) was added from LLM source reading rather than the candidate CSVs; evidence: lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py:1915-1916, lib/ansible/plugins/action/__init__.py:1037.

Batches: S1 module_params (561), S2 cli_args (363), S3 task_args/env/stdin (283), S4 remote/deserialized (42), K1 run_command (323), K2 subprocess (38), K3 action/connection layer (40), K4 pexpect/wrappers (15). Per-batch judgment files: iris/labels/_work/out_*.jsonl; rubric: iris/labels/_work/rubric.md.
PyVul ground truth and fix commits were not consulted; source tree and databases unmodified.
